Property Physical Verification in Hyderabad

Documents can't tell you who's living there or whether the plot is encroached. We inspect the property on the ground and report what's really there.

Key Takeaways

  • Physical verification is an on-site inspection of a property's real condition, occupancy and boundaries.
  • It reveals encroachment, unauthorised occupants and construction that documents never show.
  • Essential before buying, and for NRIs and absentee owners who can't visit themselves.
  • Pairs with document due diligence to confirm paper matches the ground.
  • We inspect and report with photos and a clear summary.

A property can have perfect documents and still be occupied by a tenant who won't leave, encroached by a neighbour, or in a different condition than claimed. Only a site visit reveals this.

JaaGa carries out a physical verification — inspecting the property's condition, occupancy and boundaries on the ground — and reports back with photos so you know exactly what you're dealing with.

When You Need Physical Verification

Before buying any property, to confirm its condition, occupancy and boundaries match the seller's claims.

For NRIs and absentee owners who need eyes on their property but can't visit in person.

How We Verify On-Site

  1. 1

    Confirm the Property

    We take the address, survey/plot number and what you want checked.

  2. 2

    Site Inspection

    Our team visits and inspects condition, occupancy, access and boundaries.

  3. 3

    Cross-Check Documents

    We compare what's on the ground against the documents and records.

  4. 4

    Report with Photos

    You receive a report with photos and a plain-language summary of findings.

Documents Required

  • Property address and survey/plot number
  • Sale deed / plot document (if available)
  • Specific concerns to check
  • Owner / seller contact for access

Common Problems We Solve

Unauthorised occupants

Tenants or occupants who complicate a sale often aren't disclosed. We find them.

Encroachment on plots

Open plots get encroached quietly. A site visit catches it.

Condition vs claims

The property's real state may differ from photos. We report the truth.

Why Physical Verification Matters

The most avoidable buying mistakes come from never seeing the property — paying for land that's encroached, or a flat with an occupant who won't leave. A physical verification is the ground-truth check that documents can't give.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does physical verification cover?

On-site inspection of the property's condition, occupancy, access and boundaries, cross-checked against the documents.

Is it useful if the documents are clean?

Yes — clean documents don't reveal encroachment, occupants or condition. The site visit does.

Do I get photos?

Yes, the report includes photos and a clear summary of what was found.

Is this designed for NRIs?

Very much — it's the on-ground check absentee owners can't do themselves.

Can you check a specific concern?

Yes — tell us what to focus on (occupants, boundary, construction) and we report on it.
